text: Yes, we've got a cat called Barsik, who's about eight now. He's very independent — he ignores everyone most of the day and then suddenly demands attention at two in the morning. Still, I can't imagine the flat without him.

tips.en: Not just “I have a cat” but what he is like, with a funny example.
tips.kk: Жай «мысығым бар» емес, оның қандай екені — күлкілі мысалмен.
tips.ru: Не просто «есть кот», а какой он — с забавным примером.
tips.example: suddenly demands attention at two in the morning

tips.en: Still introduces a conclusion after a complaint, which sounds natural.
tips.kk: Still шағымнан кейін қорытынды енгізеді — жауап табиғи естіледі.
tips.ru: Still вводит итог после жалобы — ответ звучит естественно.
tips.example: Still, I can't imagine the flat without him

questions.followUp: Did you have one as a child?
questions.question: Do you have a pet?

text: Probably the snow leopard. It's one of the symbols of Kazakhstan, and it lives high up in the Tian Shan mountains, so hardly anyone ever sees one in the wild. I love the idea that such a powerful animal can stay almost invisible — there's something mysterious about it.

tips.en: Where it lives and why it is known make the answer informative.
tips.kk: Қайда мекендейді және немен белгілі — жауап мазмұнды.
tips.ru: Где живёт и чем известен — ответ информативный.
tips.example: It's one of the symbols of Kazakhstan

tips.en: I love the idea that is an elegant way to explain a choice.
tips.kk: I love the idea that — таңдауды түсіндірудің әдемі тәсілі.
tips.ru: I love the idea that — изящный способ объяснить выбор.
tips.example: I love the idea that such a powerful animal can stay almost invisible

questions.question: What is your favourite animal?

text: Yes, and more and more so. Cats have always been common, but in the last few years I've noticed a lot more people walking dogs in the city, and there are even dog-friendly cafés now. In villages, though, animals are still seen as working animals rather than as pets.

tips.en: More and more so and in the last few years show a change, not just a fact.
tips.kk: More and more so және in the last few years жай деректі емес, өзгерісті көрсетеді.
tips.ru: More and more so и in the last few years показывают перемену, а не просто факт.
tips.example: in the last few years I've noticed a lot more people walking dogs

tips.en: Though inside a clause brings in a contrast.
tips.example: In villages, though, animals are still seen as working animals

questions.question: Are pets popular in your country?

text: Yes, the Almaty Zoo, several times as a kid. I remember being amazed by the elephants, but looking back, some of the enclosures seemed far too small. I think I'd enjoy a modern wildlife park much more, where the animals have space and you feel like a visitor in their world.

tips.en: Looking back shows how the view has changed over time.
tips.kk: Looking back көзқарастың уақыт өте қалай өзгергенін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Looking back показывает, как мнение изменилось со временем.
tips.example: but looking back, some of the enclosures seemed far too small

tips.en: Would enjoy … much more suggests a better option.
tips.kk: Would enjoy … much more — жақсырақ нұсқаны ұсыну.
tips.ru: Would enjoy … much more — предложение лучшего варианта.
tips.example: I think I'd enjoy a modern wildlife park much more

note.en: “I remember how surprised I was by”.

text: I think it's a great idea if the family can manage it. Looking after a pet teaches children responsibility in a very practical way — if you forget to feed the dog, you see the result immediately. It also helps shy kids, because animals don't judge them.

tips.en: If the family can manage it makes the view careful and balanced.
tips.kk: If the family can manage it — байыпты, салмақты ұстаным.
tips.ru: If the family can manage it — осторожная, взвешенная позиция.
tips.example: if the family can manage it

tips.en: The dog example makes the abstract idea of responsibility clear.
tips.kk: Ит туралы мысал дерексіз «жауапкершілікті» түсінікті етеді.
tips.ru: Пример с собакой делает абстрактную «ответственность» понятной.
tips.example: if you forget to feed the dog, you see the result immediately
